question: Who among the following took charge as the CEO and Managing Director of HDFC Bank In October 2020 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sashidhar Jagdishan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sashidhar Jagdishan took charge as the CEO and Managing Director of HDFC Bank In October 2020**__.

 __
 
• **He replaced Aditya Puri**.
 
• The appointment is for a period of three years starting 27 October 2020.
 
• He joined the bank as a manager in the finance division in 1996 and went on to become the finance head in 1999.
 
• Subsequently, he was appointed as the chief financial officer of HDFC Bank in 2008.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amitabh Chaudhry** is the Chief Executive Officer of Axis Bank.
 
• **Sandeep Bakhshi** is the Chief Executive Officer of ICICI Bank.
 
• **Rakesh Sharma **is the Chief Executive Officer of IDBI Bank.
